subject: Status of our shipment 45983 to RUH, 1144 kg
body:
Hello,

could you please tell me the current status of our shipment: Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, 45983 to RUH, 1144 kg, ready on 2026-11-29? Where is it now?

classification.reasoning: The sender asks for the current status and location of a shipment.
